name: Kamikura Hiroki
source: The main character of Canvas 2. He is the older cousin of [url=/c5934]Elis[/url] as well as her current guardian. At the time of the VN, he is an adviser to the art club as well as an art teacher.  He once had dreams of becoming a professional painter when he was in high school, but events led him down another path. He is the childhood friend of [url=/c5931]Kiri[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/c10595]Yanagi[/url].
